Fixed the nested `fallback_service` / `nest_service` panic in `axum/src/extract/matched_path.rs`.

The nested route now unconditionally removes a pre-existing `MatchedPath` after storing the internal nested-path marker. This is required when an outer fallback router already matched the request before dispatching into a nested service such as `ServeDir`.
